mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cart WHERE memId=#{memId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cart c, product p WHERE c.prdNo=p.prdNo AND c.memId=#{memId} AND c.cartQty > p.prdStock
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_info(ordNo, memId, ordReceiver, ordRcvZipcode, ordRcvAddress1, ordRcvAddress2, ordRcvPhone) VALUES(#{ordNo}, #{memId}, #{ordReceiver}, #{ordRcvZipcode}, #{ordRcvAddress1}, #{ordRcvAddress2}, #{ordRcvPhone})
INSERT INTO order_product(ordNo, prdNo, ordQty) SELECT #{ordNo}, prdNo, cartQty FROM cart WHERE memId=#{memId}
mapper.update: UPDATE product p SET prdStock = prdStock - (SELECT c.cartQty FROM cart c WHERE c.prdNo=p.prdNo AND c.memId=#{memId}) WHERE prdNo IN (SELECT prdNo FROM cart WHERE memId=#{memId})
UPDATE order_info SET ordStatus=#{ordStatus} WHERE ordNo=#{ordNo}
